#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

void simplify(long long &num, long long &den)
{
    long long p, q, r;
    if (num > den) { p = num; q = den; }
    else { p = den; q = num; }

    if (q == 0) return;

    while (q != 0)
    {
        r = p % q;
        p = q;
        q = r;
    }

    num /= p;
    den /= p;
}

int main()
{
    long long x, y, n;
    while (cin >> x >> y >> n)
    {
        long long a, b;

        if (y <= n)
        {
            a = x;
            b = y;
        }
        else
        {
            float min = 1.0f;
            float mi;

            for (long long i = 1; i <= n; i++)
            {
                long long k = i * x / y;

                mi = (float)((double)x / y - (double)k / i);
                if (mi < min)
                {
                    min = mi;
                    a = k;
                    b = i;
                }

                mi = (float)((double)(k + 1) / i - (double)x / y);
                if (mi < min)
                {
                    min = mi;
                    a = k + 1;
                    b = i;
                }
            }
        }

        simplify(a, b);
        cout << a << "/" << b << endl;
    }

    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

struct Fraction
{
    long long num;
    long long den;
};

void reduce(Fraction &f)
{
    long long greater = f.num > f.den ? f.num : f.den;
    long long smaller = f.num > f.den ? f.den : f.num;

    if (smaller == 0)
    {
        greater = 1;
        return;
    }

    long long remainder;
    while (smaller != 0)
    {
        remainder = greater % smaller;
        greater = smaller;
        smaller = remainder;
    }

    f.num /= greater;
    f.den /= greater;
}

int main()
{
    long long x, y, limit;
    while (cin >> x >> y >> limit)
    {
        Fraction ans;

        if (y <= limit)
        {

            ans.den = y;

                if (err < best)

                    ans.den = i;
                }

#include <iostream>

void search_best(long long x, long long y, long long limit, long long frac[2])
{
    float best = 1.0f;
    float err;

    for (long long i = 1; i <= limit; i++)
    {
        long long k = i * x / y;

        err = (float)((double)x / (double)y - (double)k / (double)i);
        if (err < best)
        {
            best = err;
            frac[0] = k;
            frac[1] = i;
        }

        err = (float)((double)(k + 1) / (double)i - (double)x / (double)y);
        if (err < best)
        {
            best = err;
            frac[0] = k + 1;
            frac[1] = i;
        }
    }
}

void reduce_array(long long frac[2])
{
    long long greater = frac[0] > frac[1] ? frac[0] : frac[1];
    long long smaller = frac[0] > frac[1] ? frac[1] : frac[0];
    long long rem = 1;

    if (smaller == 0)
    {
        greater = 1;
    }
    else
    {
        while (smaller != 0)
        {
            rem = greater % smaller;
            greater = smaller;
            smaller = rem;
        }
    }

    if (rem != 1)
    {
        frac[0] /= greater;
        frac[1] /= greater;
    }
}

int main()
{
    long long x, y, limit;
    while (cin >> x >> y >> limit)
    {
        long long ans[2];

        if (y <= limit)
        {
            ans[0] = x;
            ans[1] = y;
        }
        else
        {
            search_best(x, y, limit, ans);
        }

        reduce_array(ans);
        cout << ans[0] << "/" << ans[1] << endl;
    }

    return 0;
